description.zh: 是否查询详细信息。取值说明如下：true：要查询详细信息；false：不查询详细信息。
description.en:
Specifies whether to query detailed information. Valid values:
- true: Query detailed information.
- false: Do not query detailed information.

description.zh: 需要查询的消费端 Group ID
description.en: The Group ID of the consumer to query.

description.zh: 需查询的 Group ID 所对应的实例 ID。针对有独立命名空间的实例，该参数为必填。
description.en: The instance ID that corresponds to the Group ID to query. This parameter is required for instances that have independent namespaces.

description.zh: 是否打印 Jstack 信息
description.en: Specifies whether to print Jstack information.
